title: the Deep Rising Revisited
premise: Noor Hartwell has spent eleven years alone tending Earth's last seed vault, keeping alive a beacon whose original purpose was erased from every archive. When a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, Noor deciphers it and discovers testimony from the Kessari Massacre — an atrocity so thoroughly scrubbed from history that even its victims' descendants believe their ancestors died of plague. Pursued by the Concord's record-keepers who will kill to keep the erasure intact, Noor joins a ragged crew of memory-smugglers who become the family they never had. Together they broadcast the recovered testimony to every colony in human space, forcing the Concord to publicly acknowledge the massacre — and Noor, once a caretaker of seeds, becomes the caretaker of a truth that finally takes root.
about_author: Gideon Lockridge is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing declassified colonial records before turning to fiction. They write about the people history forgets on purpose, and live somewhere with poor internet reception by choice.

chapters.title: The Beacon Nobody Ordered
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Establishes the seed vault's silence, Noor's rituals, and the beacon that transmits to no known recipient. Emotional beat: loneliness worn as devotion.

chapters.title: A Language With No Speakers
chapters.summary: Noor intercepts a fragmented distress signal in dead Kessari. Using archived linguistic seeds, they begin translation. Emotional beat: first crack of wonder in years of routine.

chapters.title: Testimony in the Static
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. The signal resolves into a survivor's eyewitness account of the Kessari Massacre — but cross-referenced records insist no such event occurred. Emotional beat: vertigo of doubting reality itself.

chapters.title: The Archivists Knock
chapters.summary: Concord record-keepers arrive at the vault asking oddly specific questions about Noor's transmissions. Noor hides the decryption. Emotional beat: fear sharpening into defiance.

chapters.title: Thieves of Memory
chapters.summary: Crew POV (captain Sefa Okonkwo). Introduces the memory-smuggler ship Vagrant Choir: Sefa, hacker Dov, ex-Concord auditor Pell, and Kessari-descendant teen Wren. Emotional beat: found-family warmth with sharp edges.

chapters.title: The Vault Breach
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. The Concord raids the vault; Noor escapes with the testimony core aboard the Vagrant Choir, leaving behind everything they tended for eleven years. Emotional beat: grief and liberation entangled.

chapters.title: What Wren Carries
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. She reveals her community's oral legends of a 'plague' that killed their founders — legends the testimony contradicts. Emotional beat: hope that feels like betrayal of her elders.

chapters.title: Pell's Confession
chapters.summary: Pell's POV. He admits he helped design the archival erasure protocol years ago and has been running ever since. Emotional beat: guilt seeking absolution through action.

chapters.title: Running the Silence Corridors
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. A tense chase through sensor-dead shipping lanes as Concord hunters close in. Dov's improvisations save them. Emotional beat: trust forged under fire.

chapters.title: The Second Witness
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Decryption reveals a second voice in the signal — the perpetrator's log, confirming orders came from the Concord itself. Emotional beat: horror hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Dov's Price
chapters.summary: Dov's POV. To trace where the erasure order originated, he must burn his anonymous network identity, exposing himself to old debts. Emotional beat: sacrifice chosen freely.

chapters.title: Colony of the Disbelieved
chapters.summary: Ensemble. The crew reaches a Kessari-descendant colony to verify testimony against physical evidence — mass graves mislabeled as quarantine sites. Emotional beat: grief made communal.

chapters.title: The Trap at Meridian Gate
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. A supposed ally sells their route; the Choir barely escapes an ambush, and Wren is captured. Emotional beat: rage and helplessness.

chapters.title: Negotiating With Ghosts
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Noor trades partial testimony data to a Concord defector for Wren's location, wrestling with whether truth can be spent like currency. Emotional beat: moral compromise.

chapters.title: Extraction
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Held in a records facility, Wren discovers her own family name in the erasure orders. The crew extracts her mid-transfer. Emotional beat: fury transformed into purpose.

chapters.title: The Root Archive
chapters.summary: Pell's POV. The crew infiltrates the Concord's master archive, where Pell's old access codes still open one door — the room where the massacre was deleted. Emotional beat: returning to the scene of one's sin.

chapters.title: Everything That Was Cut
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Inside the root archive, they find not just the Kessari files but hundreds of other erased events. Emotional beat: scale of the lie nearly breaking them.

chapters.title: Broadcast
chapters.summary: Ensemble climax begins. The Choir hijacks the Concord's own relay lattice to transmit all testimony simultaneously; hunters converge. Emotional beat: terror and triumph in the same breath.

chapters.title: The Long Minute
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. As colonies receive the broadcast, Wren reads her ancestors' names aloud on open channels while Concord ships bear down. Emotional beat: witness as weapon.

chapters.title: Reckoning
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Public acknowledgment forces the Concord to stand down; the hunters receive recall orders mid-assault. Pell surrenders voluntarily to testify. Emotional beat: justice arriving imperfect but real.

chapters.title: Seeds and Stones
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Months later: memorials built, archives reopened, the crew scattered across new callings. Noor returns to the vault — not alone this time. Emotional beat: mourning braided with belonging.

chapters.title: The Beacon Answers
chapters.summary: Final chapter, Noor's POV. Noor reprograms the beacon to carry new testimony forward, and receives a reply from another forgotten listener out in the dark. Emotional beat: quiet, enduring hope.
